plainTranslation: A's love and values meets B's need for freedom. The trine lets them flow together easily.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from project-authored synastry matrix material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
summaryShort: Their affection, preferences, and wish to keep things pleasant work smoothly with your need for freedom and openness to change.
summaryDeep: Their affection, preferences, and wish to keep things pleasant work smoothly with your need for freedom and openness to change. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
